$comment: Machine-readable feature contract for this lab. Convention from Anthropic's 'Effective harnesses for long-running agents': every feature carries a category, a description, step-by-step verification, and a boolean `passes` that may only be set true by an agent that actually ran the verification. `passes: false` is not a bug report — it means 'not verified by this method yet'. Human-readable companion: features.md
project: R-KNav episode and dataset route maps

code_location.note: Code is not vendored into this lab. See harness/architecture.md.

verification_methods.automated: bun run validate in the fork (type-check, lint, format check, unit tests)
verification_methods.data: Node/bun script reading the local sample parquet under data/raw/
verification_methods.browser: Manual or MCP-driven browser session against the production build (bun run build && bun run start)

features.description: The Episodes view shows an interactive basemap with the current episode's full recorded route.
verification: Open /robotcom/R-KNav_sample/episode_0 on the production build.
Confirm a map appears between the language instruction and the charts.
Confirm the route polyline and the basemap tiles both render.

features.description: The episode map's marker tracks the shared playback clock, and clicking the route or a chart seeks it.
verification: Play the episode and confirm the marker advances with the video.
Click a point on the route; confirm video and charts jump to that frame.
Click a chart; confirm the map marker moves.

features.description: A feature is treated as geographic only via explicit config, self-describing `names`, or a documented allowlist — never guessed from shape.
verification: Run the geoTrack unit tests.
Confirm a float32[2] feature with no naming evidence resolves to no-candidate, not to a map.

features.description: A coordinate track entirely outside geographic range is treated as a local/metric frame and never drawn on a world basemap.
verification: Run the geoTrack unit tests covering out-of-range fixtures.
Confirm `looksLocalFrame` suppresses both the episode map and the dataset map.

features.description: Datasets that declare no geographic feature render exactly as upstream: no map, no Leaflet download, no chart change.
verification: Load youliangtan/so101-table-cleanup and rabhishek100/so100_train_dataset.
Confirm no map element, zero Leaflet requests, no page errors.
Confirm the Map tab reports that the dataset declares no geographic feature.
features.note: Verified for the episode map on 2026-09-07. The Map tab's behaviour on these datasets has not been re-checked since it was added.

features.description: A Map tab sits immediately after Episodes and opens a dataset-wide route map.
verification: Open any episode of robotcom/R-KNav_sample.
Confirm a 'Map' tab is the second tab in the bar.
Open it and confirm a map fills the tab body.

features.description: The Map tab draws every loaded episode's route on one basemap, framed so all of them are visible, and pans/zooms across the whole extent.
verification: Open the Map tab on robotcom/R-KNav_sample.
Confirm 14 routes are reported in the readout.
Confirm the initial view frames the continental United States.
Pan and zoom to each of the 9 distinct sites and confirm a route is drawn there.

features.description: Each route on the dataset map carries the same start and end symbols as the episode map — a triangle and a square, distinguishable without colour.
verification: Zoom to one site on the Map tab.
Confirm a green triangle at each route start and a red square at each end.
Confirm the symbols match the episode map's.
features.note: Shapes are shared code (utils/geoMarkers.ts), so drift is impossible; the rendering itself is unverified.

features.description: Routes are reduced by radial filtering plus Douglas-Peucker before reaching the browser, preserving corners rather than sampling every Nth frame.
verification: Run the datasetRoutes unit tests.
Run a data script over the sample parquet and confirm 18,054 frames reduce to roughly 620 drawn vertices with route shape retained.

features.description: One pathological episode cannot freeze the Map tab: Douglas-Peucker's quadratic worst case is bounded by a hard input cap.
verification: Run the datasetRoutes test 'bounds its own work on an adversarial path'.
Confirm 60,000 corner-only points complete in under 4 seconds.

features.description: The Map tab costs nothing until opened: no extra data shard is fetched while the user stays on Episodes.
verification: Open an episode with the network panel recording.
Confirm no additional parquet request until the Map tab is selected.
Confirm the Leaflet chunk is not in any shared bundle.
features.note: Built 2026-09-08; lazy loading is implemented but the request count has not been measured.

features.description: The dataset map reads only `index`, `episode_index` and the coordinate column, and fetches each data shard once regardless of how many episodes it holds.
verification: Inspect loadAllEpisodeRoutes' readParquetAsObjects column list.
Confirm episodes are grouped by chunk/file before fetching.

features.description: The default basemap is declared a development endpoint in the UI, and no tile prefetching or bulk downloading occurs.
verification: Confirm the readout names the OSM Standard tiles as a development basemap.
Confirm keepBuffer is 1 and no tile is requested outside the viewport margin.
features.note: Wording is in place on both maps; measurement was done for the episode map only.

features.description: No R-KNav artifact is committed to either repository; data is fetched from the Hub at runtime under the viewer's own credentials.
verification: Confirm .gitignore excludes data/ and parquet/mp4 artifacts.
Confirm git ls-files shows no dataset file.
Confirm the app carries no server-side Hugging Face token.

features.description: Route endpoints are distinguishable by shape, not colour alone, and every map region carries an accessible name.
verification: Confirm start/end/current markers are a triangle, a square and a circle.
Confirm each map container has role and aria-label.
Confirm the page renders correctly under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
features.note: Verified for the episode map on 2026-09-07. The dataset map reuses the same symbols and carries the same roles, but has not been re-checked.
